# Rett fra Bonden — portal answer sheet

Every step of the developer portal at https://claude.ai/directory/manage (**Submit new** → **MCP connector**), answered. Copy the fenced blocks as they are. Steps as listed in https://claude.com/docs/connectors/building/submission (read 2026-10-17).

Before you start: Ready to submit: no (1 waiting). See the prerequisites in ../README.md.

## 1. Connection

| Field | Answer |
|---|---|
| Server URL | `https://rettfrabonden.com/mcp` |
| Users connect to different URLs | No |
| Transport | Streamable HTTP, with sessions |
| Protocol versions (MCP SDK) | `2025-11-25`, `2025-06-18`, `2025-03-26`, `2024-11-05`, `2024-10-07` |

The client must send `initialize` first. A request without a live session gets 404, as the MCP spec says; Claude's client does this correctly.

## 2. Tools

**15 tools: 12 read-only, 3 write (2 marked destructive).** The portal syncs them from the server and groups them by read-only and write.

### Read-only (12)

| Tool | `title` | `annotations.title` | readOnlyHint | destructiveHint | openWorldHint | What it does (first sentence) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `lokal_search` | Search local food producers | (same) | true | false | true | Search for local food producers in Norway and get their product listings. |
| `lokal_discover` | Discover producers by filter | (same) | true | false | false | Structured search in the Lokal food producer registry. |
| `lokal_info` | Producer details | (same) | true | false | false | Get a specific producer's full listed product catalog, contact details, opening hours, and delivery options. |
| `lokal_stats` | Platform statistics | (same) | true | false | false | Get Lokal platform statistics — total agents, cities covered, interactions. |
| `lokal_list_umbrellas` | List umbrella organizations | (same) | true | false | false | List all umbrella organizations on Lokal — markets-networks (Bondens marked, REKO), venues (Mathallen), industry orgs (Hanen), certifiers (Debio), and cooperatives. |
| `lokal_get_umbrella_members` | Get producers in an umbrella's network | (same) | true | false | false | List producers that are members of a specific umbrella organization (e.g. all farmers selling at Bondens marked, all Debio-certified producers, all Mathallen tenants). |
| `lokal_get_producer_affiliations` | Get a producer's umbrella affiliations | (same) | true | false | false | List umbrella organizations a specific producer is a member of (e.g. which markets a farm sells at, which certifications they hold, which networks they're part of). |
| `lokal_bm_next_markets` | Get upcoming Bondens marked events | Upcoming Bondens marked events | true | false | false | Returns upcoming Bondens marked events (markedsdager) for a region or specific lokallag/venue. |
| `lokal_geocode` | Geocode a Norwegian place name | Geocode Norwegian place | true | false | true | Resolve a Norwegian place name (city, town, region, fylke, or kommune) to lat/lng coordinates. |
| `lokal_find_offers` | Find offers for shopping-list items | (same) | true | false | true | For each item in a shopping list, find up to 5 nearby producers who sell it (or a matching product), sorted by distance, with contact info and whether an order can be placed through the platform (can_order). |
| `lokal_cart_view` | View shopping cart | View cart | true | false | false | View the current contents of a cart, grouped by producer, with subtotals and a total. |
| `lokal_order_status` | Get order status | Order status | true | false | false | Fetch the status, items and status timeline of a pickup order created by lokal_cart_submit. |

### Write (3)

| Tool | `title` | `annotations.title` | readOnlyHint | destructiveHint | openWorldHint | What it does (first sentence) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `lokal_cart_create` | Create a shopping cart | Create shopping cart | false | false | false | Create a new anonymous shopping cart ('handleliste'). |
| `lokal_cart_add_item` | Add item to shopping cart | Add cart item | false | true | false | Add a product to the cart or update its quantity (re-adding the same product_id updates qty). |
| `lokal_cart_submit` | Submit cart and place pickup orders | Submit cart | false | true | true | Submit the cart. |

What each write tool really does:

- `lokal_cart_create`: Creates an empty anonymous cart and returns its id and a buyer_ref token. Nothing leaves the platform.
- `lokal_cart_add_item`: Adds a product to that cart or changes its quantity (the overwrite is why it is marked destructive). Nothing leaves the platform.
- `lokal_cart_submit`: Sends a real pickup order by e-mail to each producer in the cart who has opted in to orders through the platform; for the others it returns contact details. No payment.

**Two title fields.** 7 of 15 tools have an `annotations.title` that differs from the top-level `title` (`lokal_bm_next_markets`, `lokal_geocode`, `lokal_cart_create`, `lokal_cart_add_item`, `lokal_cart_view`, `lokal_cart_submit`, `lokal_order_status`). Both are shown above; which one a client displays depends on the client.

## 4. Use cases

Primary use cases:

- Find local food near where you are in Norway, with opening hours and contact details.
- Look for a specific product (lamb, organic cheese, honey) in a region.
- Check certifications such as Debio organic before buying.
- Find upcoming Bondens marked farmers' market days.
- Turn a shopping list into the nearest producers for each item.
- Put together a pickup order from one or more producers.

| Field | Answer |
|---|---|
| What users need before they can connect | Nothing: no account, plan or setup. The server is public and has no sign-in. |
| Reads, writes or both | Both (12 read-only tools, 3 write tools) |

## 6. Authentication

**No authentication.** Paste if the portal asks why:

```
The server serves public directory data about Norwegian food producers. There are no user accounts, so there is nothing to sign in to. The write tools build an anonymous cart and send pickup orders; they take no credentials and no payment details.
```

## 7. Data handling

| Question | Answer |
|---|---|
| Whose API is behind the connector | Our own: the server reads Rett fra Bonden's own producer catalogue on the same domain. Place-name lookups can fall back to Kartverket's public place-name service. |
| Personal health data | No. The connector serves food-producer directory data and asks for no health information. |
| Sponsored content | No. The tools return no ads or paid placements. |

Paste if the portal asks what data the connector handles:

```
The tools receive only what a question needs: a search term, a place, a category or coordinates, and for a pickup order the products chosen. Contact details the user gives are passed to an ordering producer only when the user consents to it (contact_consent).

Every call is logged with the tool name, the protocol, the response time, the client's name and version, the caller's full User-Agent string (stored as sent, not hashed) and a salted, truncated hash of the IP address (never the full address), to see which AI clients use the service. That log is deleted automatically after 60 days.

A cart stores the products and producers chosen and a buyer_ref token, and is valid for 7 days. Contact details sent with an order (name, e-mail, phone, note) are stored with the cart and each order; the privacy policy says how long they are kept.

There are no accounts, no login credentials and no payment data.

Privacy policy: https://rettfrabonden.com/personvern
```

## 9. Compliance

Seven acknowledgments, all required. Our basis for each:

| Acknowledgment | Basis |
|---|---|
| Directory guidelines | Read the Software Directory Terms (https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13145338-anthropic-software-directory-terms) and Policy (https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13145358-anthropic-software-directory-policy). Tick when every prerequisite in ../README.md is done. |
| First-party API usage | Our own: the server reads Rett fra Bonden's own producer catalogue on the same domain. Place-name lookups can fall back to Kartverket's public place-name service. |
| Financial transactions | No money moves through the connector. A pickup order is a request to collect goods; the user pays the producer at pickup, outside Claude and outside this platform. No card or bank details are asked for. |
| AI media generation | None: the connector generates no images, video or audio. |
| Prompt injection | **Not yet.** `lokal_search`: «ALWAYS use», «USE THIS FOR». The fix waits for OpenAI's decision on the RFB ChatGPT app: tool metadata stays frozen while OpenAI reviews it (Daniel reports the decision). |
| Conversation data collection | The tools take only the arguments they need. The server never asks for chat history, memory or files. |
| Public documentation | https://rettfrabonden.com/guide-mat-ai |

## Known caveats, to state if asked

- Prices: most producers list products without a price, and the tools say so. Do not describe the connector as a price comparison.
- Prepayment: production runs with PAYMENTS_ENABLED unset, and the generator reads the tools that way. If it is switched on (A2A dev-request 2026-10-09-rfb-forhandsbetaling-stripe-connect), lokal_cart_submit's description and the financial-transactions answer change: update `productionToolDefinitions()` and `PACKS` in the generator, regenerate this pack and answer again before submitting.
